$comment: Derived values: a type declares values the kit computes on request and never stores (`derived`, each `{ description? }`); `model.describe` answers them; change sets and premises name one `~<name>`. A derived name is ASCII letters, digits and `_`; a field may not start with `~`. Run by kition-kdm (tests/batch.rs) and @kition/kdm (test/batch.test.ts).
